sources.snippet: Recipe Lens In this project introduces an inverse cooking system that takes a food image and recreate a cooking recipes consisting of a title, ingredients, sequence of cooking instructions, Calorie, Cooking time. This model predicts ingredients as sets by means of DenseNet201 and Recipe Retrieval Algorithm.
